item.description: In Syria, two energy pipelines were damaged today. An explosion set the Jbessa gas line ablaze in Hasakah, while a separate breach on the Baniyas-Homs fuel line caused a leak & road closure. Syrian authorities allege sabotage.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

In Syria, two energy pipelines were damaged today. An explosion set the Jbessa gas line ablaze in Hasakah, while a separate breach on the Baniyas-Homs fuel line caused a leak & road closure. Syrian authorities allege sabotage.
